prompt:
Make a clean high-resolution named component reference sheet, not a whole room/building. Use ONLY the one supplied source for material/motif vocabulary. Owner-requested new variations and junctions must stay coordinated with it. Separate complete objects, no fused neighbors, no cropped silhouettes, no shadows over patterns, no melting scrolls or warped rails. Straight edges/columns remain straight; thin gold stays thin. Warm-white background, even light. Print exact full ID AND short name below EVERY item, title above. One object per cell, no duplicate alternate views. Palette/style follows this source. Source illustrations are not measured models; do not invent fixed palace dimensions. No people, whole buildings, scenery, plants or loose decoration glued onto parts.

The supplied wall-bay source is the shared lotus/star/rose vocabulary; the four room-specific variants are explicitly newly requested coordinated alternatives. Never draw a complete room or big structural wall. Clean slight three-quarter product views, moderate restrained source carving; no melted flowers, spikes or glass windows inserted into cornice bands.

repeat_contract.cornice_rule: Same profile and motif phase at left/right ends within each style; inside returns turn that same profile
repeat_contract.wall_rule: One full ornament period per backed panel; same top/bottom bands at neighboring ends
repeat_contract.pillar_rule: Collars normalize to actual pillar radius before fitting; open/closed support class is preserved
repeat_contract.cross_style_rule: Do not assume different style profiles mate; use blank transition/end cap or change at architectural corner

review_notes: Four requested room variants derived from existing lotus/star/rose palette. These are coordinated proposals, not proof that all four variants appear literally in the source bay.
Split collar halves belong to one assembly ID; actual collar radius and motif end phase need normalization.
